item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Israel Launches Attacks in Lebanon as Iran Fires on U.S. Allies
item.summary: The United States temporarily lifted sanctions on some Iranian oil in an effort to ease surging global oil prices.

item.title: Zelensky Sends Negotiators to the U.S., Hoping to Revive Peace Talks
item.summary: The Ukrainian president has said he has a “very bad feeling” about the effects of the Iran conflict on Ukraine’s own war.

item.title: Iranian Sailors, Including Survivors of Torpedoed Ship, Remain in Limbo
item.summary: Sri Lanka has kept more than 250 sailors in protective custody since the early days of the war. Iran wants them back, but Sri Lanka is unsure what to do with them.

item.title: A Public Holiday Every Week? Sri Lankans Bemoan the Enforced Day Off.
item.summary: The island’s government, rationing fuel amid shortages from the Iran war, surprised residents by imposing an unusual four-day week.

item.title: On a Holiday of Renewal, Iranians Are Mourning and Fearful
item.summary: As they start a new year, Iranians are reckoning with bombardment, repression and economic misery. Still, many are holding fast to ancient traditions.

item.title: A Diary of War From an Unlikely Author: the Son of Iran’s President
item.summary: In an online journal, Yousef Pezeshkian offers readers a mix of personal anecdotes and glimpses behind the scenes as Iranian leaders are picked off one after another.

item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in Iran in Its Third Week
item.summary: The Persian new year and the end of the holy month of Ramadan were marked by continuing strikes in the region as the war reached the end of its third week.

item.title: U.S. Attacks Iranian Targets to Try to Open Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: The Israeli military said it had killed the spokesman for Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps, and Iran warned that it could target American and Israeli military personnel.

item.title: Trump Signals Retreat From Goal of Regime Change in Iran
item.summary: In the first days of the U.S.-Israeli campaign against Iran, Mr. Trump pressed for a popular uprising against Tehran’s government.

item.title: Live Updates: BTS Takes the Stage After Nearly 4 Years
item.summary: K-pop’s biggest name will perform live in Seoul at 8 p.m. South Korea time (7 a.m. Eastern). The concert will be livestreamed by Netflix.
